description: Generate a modular typographic scale from a base size and ratio: named steps (xs…6xl) with sizes, line-heights, letter-spacing, and optional fluid clamp() that scales display type down on small screens. Emits CSS custom properties and a Tailwind v4 @theme block. Deterministic real output. Pair with suggest_font_pairing and generate_design_tokens.

fluid.description: Emit fluid clamp() for headings (default true)

ratio.description: Modular ratio (default 1.25). Common: 1.2 minor-third, 1.25 major-third, 1.333 perfect-fourth, 1.5, 1.618 golden

steps.description: Named steps above base (default 7 → up to 6xl)

name: generate_type_scale
title: Generate Type Scale
